subject: Heihachi 6 hit combo
object: hold the second forward about 1-1.5 seconds
text: Start Heihachi's combo by pressing forward and holding the second forward for about 1 to 1.5 seconds, otherwise he performs Demon Uppercut; then press Triangle and continue the 10-hit combo.

evidence.quote: press forward and on the second forward you should HOLD it for about a second or 1,5. You should wait a bit, while holding the forward direction button, or Heihachi will perform Demon Uppercut
After holding the right time press triangle and start 10-hit combo, it should work okay.

subject: Heihachi 6 hit combo
text: One method: backdash until Kunimitsu does 444, then attempt the 10-hit after the last hit because Yoshimitsu/Kunimitsu 444 has huge recovery (on Easy, 5 rounds).

evidence.quote: I did this by backdashing until kunimitsu did 444 after reacting to the last hit coming out you can attempt the 10 hit because yoshi/kuni 444 has insane amounts of recovery frames (easy, 5 rounds)

subject: Heihachi 6 hit combo
text: Workaround for the aggressive AI faced as Heihachi: enable character select on lose, play as another character (preferably Easy, 5 rounds), lose on purpose, then switch to Heihachi and attempt the combo.

evidence.quote:
1. Enable Character select on lose
2. Play as any character other than Heihachi (preferrably on Easy with 5 rounds)
3. Purposely lose
4. Switch to Heihachi
an easy workaround for the crazy AI that seems exclusive to playing as Heihachi

subject: Heihachi 6 hit combo
object: release forward after the first input
text: Stop holding Forward after the first input; holding it kept the combo from continuing past the first 2-3 punches.

evidence.quote: make sure you stop holding "Forward" after the first input.

I was consistently wondering why I couldn't get the inputs to go past the first 2-3 punches. Once I worked on letting go of holding "Forward" I was more consistently getting into the combos later parts.

subject: Heihachi 6 hit combo
text: The main difficulty of Heihachi's combo is timing the delay between the dash and the punch so you do not launch the opponent; with the switch-character workaround on Easy and 5 rounds it is doable.

evidence.quote: Get used to the delay in between the dash and the punch as to not launch them, learn the timing off the buttons and from there on out it should come close to automatic.
with easy and 5 rounds you should be able to do it!

subject: Kunimitsu 6 hit combo
text: Kunimitsu has no 10 string combo, so use Yoshimitsu's string, which only goes to 7 hits; its second hitbox often drops out of the combo.

evidence.quote: This one sucks only because Kunimitsu doesn’t have a 10 string combo, so you just gotta used Yoshimitsu’s, which only goes up to 7 hits.
That second hitbox during the combo loves to fall out of combo
